description: I am a student with a deep passion for space exploration and strong skills in research, visual design, and storytelling. I love unearthing historical facts, crafting clean visual layouts in Canva, and using my creative skills to build compelling narratives about the cosmos.
summary:
I developed "The Sentinels of Silence: Waking Up the Solar System's Forgotten Hardware," an illustrated sci-fi storybook presentation designed to inspire the next generation of space explorers. Framing the audience as an astronaut on a deep-space recovery mission, the story uses authentic coordinates and mission parameters from the NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA) to track down three real, inactive pioneers: the Apollo 14 Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector on the Moon, the Opportunity rover in Mars' Perseverance Valley, and the Ingenuity helicopter in Jezero Crater.
This project directly addresses the challenge by transforming dense archival telemetry and static catalog records into an accessible, emotionally engaging narrative. Instead of letting retired spacecraft fade into obscurity as forgotten "space junk," the storybook highlights their exact launch dates, landing sites, scientific breakthroughs, and final operational statuses.
Preserving the history of these dormant pioneers is vital because their discoveries form the literal foundation for future human exploration. By teaching young learners and the general public how past missions paved the way for upcoming lunar bases and interplanetary flight, this project ensures the legacy of humanity's earliest cosmic explorers continues to inspire future missions.
details:
"The Sentinels of Silence" is an illustrated sci-fi storybook presentation that turns real NASA archive records into a first-person space recovery mission. Readers step into the role of a future astronaut using authentic coordinates and telemetry from the NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA) to locate three historic pioneers: the Apollo 14 Retroreflector on the Moon, the Opportunity rover on Mars, and the Ingenuity helicopter in Jezero Crater.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

  • Simplifies Complex Data: Transforms dense orbital telemetry and catalog logs into a fun, easy-to-follow adventure for young learners and the public.
  • Inspires Future Explorers: Shows how retired hardware forms the foundation for future human bases on the Moon and Mars.

Creativity, Key Factors & Tools:

  • Creative Storytelling: Frames inactive spacecraft as silent monuments holding the keys to deep-space travel rather than writing a dry report.
  • Balanced Design: Pairs original sci-fi narration with 100% fact-checked NASA dates, geographic variety (Moon and Mars), and bold, high-contrast visuals.
  • Tools Used: Built using NASA's NSSDCA and JPL archives for verified mission data, Canva for custom visual design and layout, and AI for suggestions and fact-checking.
